42. Pair Sum Check

50

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N,X and an array of N elements, check if there exists any 2 numbers in the array with sum equal to X.If found print 'yes' otherwise print 'no'
input_spec: The input consists of two numbers N and X, and an array of N elements. N and X are up to 100000.
output_spec: Print 'yes' if two numbers with sum equal to X are found in the array, otherwise print 'no'.
